title: POV:

Someone bought
the ocean.
subs: In 2030, a company called BlueBay bought the ocean.
In twenty thirty, a company called BlueBay bought the ocean.
All of it.
Beaches got turnstiles.
Swimming costs nine dollars an hour.
Waves are a premium feature.
Free users get the tide twice a day.
Ships now need a monthly plan.
A cruise ship was stuck for three weeks.
Its card was declined.
Then BlueBay noticed where rain comes from.
They sent everyone a bill.
People started carrying umbrellas indoors.
Just to be safe.
Lakes declared independence from the ocean.
BlueBay bought the lakes.
Today, one man still swims for free.
He found a loophole. He brings his own water.
He found a loophole. He brings his own water.
BlueBay is suing him.
